backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining backend logic for a concrete coating business, handling quote request and customer review submission/retrieval with in-memory maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that FlakeColorsSection.tsx was updated to replace CDN-hosted images with 17 local static asset paths mapped to their specific color names.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing the purpose and key details of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, setting the page title to 'NewGate Concrete Coating' and mounting the app at the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that composes the full page layout by rendering Navigation, HeroSection, ServicesSection, FlakeColorsSection, AboutSection, ContactSection, ReviewsSection, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component displaying four benefit cards (durability, aesthetics, protection, installation), a service areas badge list for Orlando, Tampa, and Plant City, and a 'NewGate Difference' callout block.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact form component with fields for name, email, phone, service type, and message that submits quote requests to the backend actor, showing a success state on completion.
frontend/src/components/FlakeColorsSecti: Flake Colors section displaying 17 decorative chip flake options in a responsive grid, each mapped to a local /assets/ image path and color name, with a CTA linking to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with company info, social media links, quick navigation links, contact details, and service areas for NewGate Concrete Coating.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, company tagline, phone CTA, and buttons to scroll to the contact or services sections.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Fixed top navigation bar with scroll-aware styling, smooth-scroll nav links, a 'Get a Free Quote' CTA button, and a responsive mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.t: Displays customer reviews fetched from the backend and provides a form for submitting new reviews with a star rating, service type, and feedback.
Renders a grid of four service cards (patio, driveway, pool deck, garage) each with an image, description, and feature tags.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, returning an anonymous actor when unauthenticated and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login/logout state, AuthClient creation, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for fetching and mutating quote requests and customer reviews via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining a concrete/copper-themed design system with CSS custom properties for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with oklch-based custom colors (copper, concrete, chart, sidebar), border radius, font family, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for NewGate Concrete Coating, tracking the completed feature of replacing Simiron CDN images with 17 user-uploaded flake color images mapped to their local asset paths.
